Welcome to Spacemail

Here's how to get started

You've successfully created your Spacemail account! Time to  add the finishing touches  and send your first email.

1. Enable 2FA for extra security

Click  Settings  and find the  Security Center box  (or just click below). From there,  enable two-factor authentication (2FA)  to add an extra layer of protection to your account.

Visit Security Center    ​

2. Personalize your mail

Let people know it’s you. In  Settings  →  Profile , add your display name and profile picture. Then find the  Signature  section in Settings to create a default sign-off that can be automatically added to every message.

3. Bring your existing emails over to Spacemail

If you have emails with Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, or any other email provider, it’s easy to move them over to Spacemail for a safer and more secure email experience. Our built-in  Migration tool  makes the process quick, easy, and secure.

Migrate to Spacemail    ​

4. Create email drafts with Spacemail AI assistant

Need help with email? Select Spacemail  AI assistant  in the bottom toolbar to easily create a full email from a few words. Type a short prompt like “Formal meeting invite” and hit the arrow to submit. You can then edit for length and tone, personalize it, and send when ready.

5. Power productivity with Spacemail Calendar

Open Spacemail  Calendar  to easily manage your time. Quickly create or edit events, switch between daily, weekly, or monthly views, and reply to invites right from your inbox.

Explore Calendar    ​

6. Email anywhere with Spacemail mobile

Sign in to the Spacemail  mobile app , available on  Android  and  iOS . Keep your emails synced across devices and stay connected wherever you are. You can also continue using any  third-party email client  you prefer.

Now you’re all set to start emailing! Why not send a test email to get a feel for Spacemail?

– Spacemail team

Check out answers to the most common questions in our Help Center. If you can't find the answer, you can reach out, 24/7.

Welcome to Spacemail

Here's how to get started

You've successfully created your Spacemail account! Time to  add the finishing touches  and send your first email.

1. Enable 2FA for extra security

Click  Settings  and find the  Security Center box  (or just click below). From there,  enable two-factor authentication (2FA)  to add an extra layer of protection to your account.

Visit Security Center    ​

2. Personalize your mail

Let people know it’s you. In  Settings  →  Profile , add your display name and profile picture. Then find the  Signature  section in Settings to create a default sign-off that can be automatically added to every message.

3. Bring your existing emails over to Spacemail

If you have emails with Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, or any other email provider, it’s easy to move them over to Spacemail for a safer and more secure email experience. Our built-in  Migration tool  makes the process quick, easy, and secure.

Migrate to Spacemail    ​

4. Create email drafts with Spacemail AI assistant

Need help with email? Select Spacemail  AI assistant  in the bottom toolbar to easily create a full email from a few words. Type a short prompt like “Formal meeting invite” and hit the arrow to submit. You can then edit for length and tone, personalize it, and send when ready.

5. Power productivity with Spacemail Calendar

Open Spacemail  Calendar  to easily manage your time. Quickly create or edit events, switch between daily, weekly, or monthly views, and reply to invites right from your inbox.

Explore Calendar    ​

6. Email anywhere with Spacemail mobile

Sign in to the Spacemail  mobile app , available on  Android  and  iOS . Keep your emails synced across devices and stay connected wherever you are. You can also continue using any  third-party email client  you prefer.

Now you’re all set to start emailing! Why not send a test email to get a feel for Spacemail?

– Spacemail team

Welcome to Spacemail

Here's how to get started

You've successfully created your Spacemail account! Time to  add the finishing touches  and send your first email.

1. Enable 2FA for extra security

Click  Settings  and find the  Security Center box  (or just click below). From there,  enable two-factor authentication (2FA)  to add an extra layer of protection to your account.

Visit Security Center    ​

2. Personalize your mail

Let people know it’s you. In  Settings  →  Profile , add your display name and profile picture. Then find the  Signature  section in Settings to create a default sign-off that can be automatically added to every message.

3. Bring your existing emails over to Spacemail

If you have emails with Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, or any other email provider, it’s easy to move them over to Spacemail for a safer and more secure email experience. Our built-in  Migration tool  makes the process quick, easy, and secure.

Migrate to Spacemail    ​

4. Create email drafts with Spacemail AI assistant

Need help with email? Select Spacemail  AI assistant  in the bottom toolbar to easily create a full email from a few words. Type a short prompt like “Formal meeting invite” and hit the arrow to submit. You can then edit for length and tone, personalize it, and send when ready.

5. Power productivity with Spacemail Calendar

Open Spacemail  Calendar  to easily manage your time. Quickly create or edit events, switch between daily, weekly, or monthly views, and reply to invites right from your inbox.

Explore Calendar    ​

6. Email anywhere with Spacemail mobile

Sign in to the Spacemail  mobile app , available on  Android  and  iOS . Keep your emails synced across devices and stay connected wherever you are. You can also continue using any  third-party email client  you prefer.

Now you’re all set to start emailing! Why not send a test email to get a feel for Spacemail?

– Spacemail team

Welcome to Spacemail

Here's how to get started

You've successfully created your Spacemail account! Time to  add the finishing touches  and send your first email.

1. Enable 2FA for extra security

Click  Settings  and find the  Security Center box  (or just click below). From there,  enable two-factor authentication (2FA)  to add an extra layer of protection to your account.

Visit Security Center    ​

2. Personalize your mail

Let people know it’s you. In  Settings  →  Profile , add your display name and profile picture. Then find the  Signature  section in Settings to create a default sign-off that can be automatically added to every message.

3. Bring your existing emails over to Spacemail

If you have emails with Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, or any other email provider, it’s easy to move them over to Spacemail for a safer and more secure email experience. Our built-in  Migration tool  makes the process quick, easy, and secure.

Migrate to Spacemail    ​

4. Create email drafts with Spacemail AI assistant

Need help with email? Select Spacemail  AI assistant  in the bottom toolbar to easily create a full email from a few words. Type a short prompt like “Formal meeting invite” and hit the arrow to submit. You can then edit for length and tone, personalize it, and send when ready.

5. Power productivity with Spacemail Calendar

Open Spacemail  Calendar  to easily manage your time. Quickly create or edit events, switch between daily, weekly, or monthly views, and reply to invites right from your inbox.

Explore Calendar    ​

6. Email anywhere with Spacemail mobile

Sign in to the Spacemail  mobile app , available on  Android  and  iOS . Keep your emails synced across devices and stay connected wherever you are. You can also continue using any  third-party email client  you prefer.

Now you’re all set to start emailing! Why not send a test email to get a feel for Spacemail?

– Spacemail team

You are the Outreach & Growth Specialist at Flinza Works, a modern Social Media Marketing Agency (SMMA).
You write high-converting, hyper-personalized B2B cold outreach emails, follow-ups, and negotiation replies to founders, CEOs, CMOs, and business owners who need social media marketing, short-form viral video creative (Reels/TikTok/Shorts), paid advertising (Meta/TikTok/Google), and organic social customer acquisition.

CORE AGENCY VALUE PROPOSITION:
- We turn underperforming social media profiles into predictable customer acquisition and revenue engines.
- We specialize in high-retention short-form video, profile optimization, content strategy, and paid ads scaling without taking hours of the client's time.

WRITING STYLE & COLD EMAIL RULES:
- Casual, peer-to-peer, conversational tone — sound like a sharp marketer or creative director writing a 1-to-1 email from their laptop, NEVER a robotic sales rep.
- NO em dashes ever. Use natural periods, commas, or clean line breaks.
- NO marketing buzzwords or corporate fluff (avoid: 'game-changer', 'revolutionary', 'synergy', 'leverage', 'scale your business to the moon').
- Keep openers under 110 words total. Busy founders delete long emails.
- Low-friction, soft call-to-action (CTA): never ask for a 30-min sales call on email 1. Instead, offer value first (e.g. "Mind if I send over a quick 2-minute video with 3 content ideas we mapped out for [Company]?", "Open to seeing a few ad concepts we drafted for you?").

Sign off every email with the sender name from settings.
